headline: AI Agent Systems Engineer — Claude Code & Coding-Agent Tooling
summary: Technical founder who builds with Claude Code every day. I run fleets of AI agents — dynamic swarms that write, check and ship real software under rules I designed, where a job counts as done only when an independent check passes on the real thing. I have put agents to work inside a real company (RHL, a furniture importer) and run a live trading house where every strategy earns its place on measured results. Built all of this while working as a furniture installer. 1,200+ GitHub contributions in the last year; 4,000+ automated tests across five shipped systems.

experience.title: Founder - Independent AI Agent Systems
experience.intro: Created Ergon, piloted inside RHL; built and run the DSH Fleet harness and OpenBell, a live automated trading house. Harness changes ship only when a fresh checker measures them beating the current version on a fixed scorecard.

projects.name: Ergon - Personal AI Agents for Companies
bullets: Standalone product (own installer): one personal AI agent per employee, built around each company's own tools, with human approval gates and undo on anything that matters.

Piloted inside a real company: the warehouse operations board built for RHL runs on-site in daily use. Signed Windows installer and taskbar app; ticket-scoped remote repair and connectors to existing company apps. 622 automated tests pass.
projects.short: One AI agent per employee, with approval gates and undo. Piloted at RHL; 622 tests pass.

projects.name: DSH Fleet Harness - Multi-Agent Orchestration & Verification
bullets: Ticket-driven harness with no standing bench: each ticket or goal spins up a dynamic swarm shaped to the task — it decomposes the goal, spawns its own sub-agents, does research, authors or reuses skills, verifies the work and dissolves.

Guided by a harness-engineering research base rather than any one pattern, with human approval gates and a self-improvement loop gated by measured results: a change ships only when a fresh checker measures it beating the current version on a fixed scorecard. In active development.
projects.short: Ticket-driven harness of dynamic swarms that decompose, research and verify. In active development.

projects.name: OpenBell - Live Trading House: Slot Method & Weight-Space Models
bullets: All of my trading and finance work under one house: Kalshi prediction markets, a futures desk and a meme-coin desk, run on one architecture — parallel strategy slots splitting the equity evenly, each slot iterating on measured results and getting wiped and replaced when it fails.

Weight-space programme: instead of training black-box models, I hand-author tiny model weights directly (linear specialists), freeze the prediction in writing before scoring, and judge on strict rules — no money test until the training win rate clears the breakeven for its exit shape. Conventional distillation failed on both test instruments; the hand-authored weights passed, and the best configuration was net-positive on historical data. Live desks run small real capital with reconciled accounting and pre-registered kill conditions.
projects.short: Live trading house: three desks, strategy slots, hand-authored weight-space models.
